item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena swings two simple pendulums in her school laboratory in Jaipur. Pendulum P and pendulum Q have the same length, but the bob of pendulum Q is heavier. Both are set swinging with small oscillations at the same place.
Which row correctly describes the time periods of the two pendulums?

options.A: P and Q have the same time period; time period depends on length, not on the mass of the bob
options.B: Q has a longer time period; time period increases with the mass of the bob
options.C: Q has a shorter time period; time period decreases with the mass of the bob
options.D: The time periods cannot be compared unless the place is changed
